reason: allowed_layers, interface_only, ownership and custom_contract need declarative checker inputs. The sealed contract 1.0 rule object only carries id/kind/description/scope_ids/required/checker_id/checkability.

field.name: parameters
field.note: Optional; omitted parameters keep the previous canonical bytes. Checker-specific keys are listed in the rule registry.

architecture.allowed_layers.v1.parameters: layers: [[component_id, ...], ...] ordered outer to inner; allow_same_layer: boolean (default true)
architecture.allowed_layers.v1.semantics: a declared candidate dependency may point to the same or an inner layer; pointing to an outer layer (or same layer when allow_same_layer=false) is a violation
architecture.allowed_layers.v1.coverage: complete_declared_graph when every component is assigned and every dependency endpoint is declared; otherwise partial

architecture.interface_only.v1.semantics: a declared cross-component dependency must have at least one endpoint in the declared interface set
architecture.interface_only.v1.coverage: partial when a declared interface id is missing from the architecture

architecture.ownership.v1.semantics: when exclusive, no owned_state or owned_resources item may be declared by more than one component

architecture.custom_contract.v1.semantics: only the small registered assertion set is executable; unknown assertions are inconclusive and required rules remain blocking

status: contract 1.0 deviation; absorb into the next pack revision
